title: Goal Bonus and Promotional Yield Conditions on Savings and Money Market Accounts
content:
Two tier-specific bonuses supplement base interest on Savings & Money Market Accounts.

### The goal bonus

The goal bonus is earned for a cycle, on a tier whose goal bonus rate stands above 0.00 percent, when the cycle's net deposits are at least the tier's minimum net deposits figure and the count of withdrawals posted in the cycle is zero. Net deposits for the cycle are the deposits posted in it less the withdrawals posted in it; interest credits, fees and refunds are left out of that measure.

Where it is earned, the goal bonus applies to every day of that cycle, on balance up to the tier's goal bonus balance cap, and is credited with the goal bonus component.

A cycle carrying any withdrawal, of any channel and including an overdraft protection transfer, earns no goal bonus.

### The promotional yield

The promotional annual percentage yield applies only on a tier whose promotional yield parameter is not the value not offered, only while the day is on or before the promotional end date, and only where the new money brought within the funding window reached the tier's minimum new money.

New money for that threshold is the total of deposits posted in the funding window through the channels of branch, deposited check, mobile deposit, ACH credit and domestic wire; internal transfers and automatic transfers from another Piedmont Crescent Bank account are never new money.

### The promotional period

The promotional yield applies only on days no later than the tier's promotional duration in calendar months after the account was opened. Calendar months are counted from the opening date, and a day is within the promotional period when it is on or before the opening date plus the tier's promotional duration in calendar months, which is the promotional end date recorded on the account. The comparison is not-later-than, so the promotional end date itself is within the period.

After the promotional end date the whole balance earns base interest and any relationship bonus. A tier conversion ends the promotional period on the conversion date.

New money deposited after the funding window has passed does not count toward the minimum new money, but it does earn the promotional annual percentage yield within the tier's promotional balance cap.

### No longer in force

The clause that defined the promotional portion of each day's balance as the balance up to the tier's promotional balance cap, credited with the promotional interest component, is no longer in force. It has been superseded, and it is not to be applied to any account of this product.

superseded_clauses: the promotional portion of each day's balance is the balance up to promo_balance_cap, credited with interest_component promotional
